<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">200 Park Avenue, 25th Floor<BR>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Re: Credit Agreement Side Letter</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">We refer to the Amended and
Restated Credit Agreement, dated as of December&nbsp;31, 2025 (as amended, restated, supplemented or otherwise modified from time to
time, the &ldquo;<U>Credit Agreement</U>&rdquo;), by and among GPIF I Funding, as borrower (&ldquo;<U>Borrower</U>&rdquo;, &ldquo;<U>we</U>&rdquo;
or &ldquo;<U>us</U>&rdquo;), the lenders from time to time party thereto, Bank of America, N.A. (&ldquo;<U>Bank of America</U>&rdquo;
or &ldquo;<U>you</U>&rdquo;), as administrative agent, Golub Capital Private Income Fund I, as servicer, Computershare Trust Company,
N.A., as collateral custodian, and Bank of America, N.A., as sole lead arranger and sole book manager. All terms used but not otherwise
defined herein shall have the meanings set forth in the Credit Agreement. This letter amends and restates in its entirety that certain
letter agreement re: Credit Agreement Side Letter dated as of December&nbsp;31, 2025. The parties to this side letter (the &ldquo;<U>Second
Amended and Restated Side Letter</U>&rdquo;) hereby agree as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">1.&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Definitions</U>.
As used herein or in the Credit Agreement, the following terms shall have the meanings set forth below:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Approved
Dealer</U>&rdquo; means each of the following entities or their Affiliates (or any successor thereto): BofA Securities,&nbsp;Inc., Barclays
Bank plc, BNP Paribas S.A., Citibank, N.A., Citizens Bank, N.A., Deutsche Bank AG, Goldman Sachs&nbsp;&amp; Co., HSBC Bank, Jefferies&nbsp;&amp;
Co., JP Morgan Securities LLC, Macquarie Bank Limited, Morgan Stanley&nbsp;&amp; Co., Nomura Corporate Funding Americas, LLC, Royal Bank
of Canada, The Royal Bank of Scotland, Soci&eacute;t&eacute; G&eacute;n&eacute;rale, Scotiabank, Truist Bank, UBS AG, Wells Fargo Bank,
National Association, KeyBank, Lloyds TSB, Northern Trust Company, Banco Santander, Truist Bank, Dresdner Bank AG, The Bank of Montreal,
The Bank of New York Mellon, U.S. Bank, or any other independent, internationally recognized third party dealer agreed to by the Administrative
Agent in writing from time to time; <U>provided</U> that neither the Servicer nor any of its Affiliates shall be an Approved Dealer.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Approved
Valuation Firm</U>&rdquo; means any of Houlihan Lokey, Murray, Devine&nbsp;&amp; Co.,&nbsp;Inc., Valuation Research Corporation, Howard&nbsp;&amp;
Zukin, FTI Consulting,&nbsp;Inc., Duff&nbsp;&amp; Phelps Corp. (or any successor-in-interest), Lincoln International LLC (f/k/a Lincoln
Partners LLC) and Alvarez&nbsp;&amp; Marsal; <I>provided</I> that any independent appraisal or valuation firm or independent financial
advisor recognized as being experienced in conducting valuations of secured loans may be added as an &ldquo;<U>Approved Valuation Firm</U>&rdquo;
by the Servicer with the consent of the Administrative Agent (such consent not to be unreasonably withheld, delayed or conditioned).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Assigned
Value</U>&rdquo; means:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(a)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>with
respect to any Permitted Collateral Asset, as of any date of determination, the higher of (i)&nbsp;zero and (ii)&nbsp;the value of such
Collateral Asset (expressed as a percentage of par) as determined by the Administrative Agent in its sole discretion as notified to the
Servicer in writing; <U>provided </U>that if a Revaluation Event of the type described in clause (a)&nbsp;of the definition thereof as
a result of an Insolvency Event or a default in the payment of principal or pursuant to clause (e)&nbsp;of the definition of &ldquo;Defaulted
Obligation&rdquo; with respect to such Collateral Asset occurs, the Assigned Value of such Collateral Asset will, automatically and without
further action by the Administrative Agent, be zero, unless the Servicer requests otherwise and such request is agreed to by the Administrative
Agent in its sole discretion, <U>provided</U>, <U>further</U>, that the Borrower (or the Servicer on behalf of the Borrower) may at any
time request that the Administrative Agent reevaluate the Assigned Value of a Permitted Collateral Asset in its sole discretion;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(b)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>with
respect to any Qualifying Syndicated Loan, as of any date of determination, the lower of (i)&nbsp;the Purchase Price with respect to
such Qualifying Syndicated Loan and (ii)&nbsp;100%; <U>provided</U> that, with respect to this <U>clause (b)</U>:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(i)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">notwithstanding
                                            <U>clause (b)(ii)</U>&nbsp;below, if a Revaluation Event of the type described in clause&nbsp;(a)&nbsp;of
                                            the definition thereof as a result of an Insolvency Event or a default in the payment of
                                            principal or pursuant to clause (e)&nbsp;of the definition of &ldquo;Defaulted Obligation&rdquo;
                                            with respect to a Qualifying Syndicated Loan occurs, the Assigned Value of such Qualifying
                                            Syndicated Loan will, automatically and without further action by the Administrative Agent,
                                            be zero, unless the Servicer requests otherwise and such request is agreed to by the Administrative
                                            Agent in its sole discretion; and</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(ii)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">if
                                            a Revaluation Event occurs with respect to a Qualifying Syndicated Loan that has an observable
                                            bid-side quote with an indicated bid-depth of one or more following such Revaluation Event,
                                            such bid-side quote shall (i)&nbsp;be determined as of each Measurement Date and (ii)&nbsp;become
                                            the Assigned Value of such Qualifying Syndicated Loan; <U>provided</U> that if the Assigned
                                            Value has changed with respect to such Qualifying Syndicated Loan as a result of this <U>clause
                                            (b)(ii)</U>, so long as no Event of Default has occurred and is continuing, (x)&nbsp;the
                                            Borrower may obtain a firm bid for such Collateral Asset from an Approved Dealer, which firm
                                            bid shall be determined, to the extent the Revaluation Event was based on financial information,
                                            with an as-of date after the financial information that gave rise to the related Revaluation
                                            Event has been made available, and such firm bid shall become the Assigned Value of such
                                            Collateral Asset if it is greater than the then-current Assigned Value; and (y)&nbsp;if such
                                            Qualifying Syndicated Loan has an observable bid-side quote with an indicated bid-depth of
                                            one, the Administrative Agent may direct the Borrower to obtain a firm bid (in addition to
                                            <U>clause (x)</U>&nbsp;above) for such Qualifying Syndicated Loan from an Approved Dealer,
                                            which firm bid shall be determined, to the extent the Revaluation Event was based on financial
                                            information, with an as-of date after the financial information that gave rise to the related
                                            Revaluation Event has been made available, and such firm bid shall become the Assigned Value
                                            of such Qualifying Syndicated Loan; <U>provided</U>, <U>further</U> that the Assigned Value
                                            determined pursuant to this <U>clause (b)(ii)</U>&nbsp;shall remain the &ldquo;Assigned Value&rdquo;
                                            of such Qualifying Syndicated Loan until the earlier of (A)&nbsp;if the &ldquo;Assigned Value&rdquo;
                                            pursuant to this <U>clause (b)(ii)</U>&nbsp;is determined pursuant to a firm bid, the earlier
                                            to occur of (X)&nbsp;thirty (30) days after such firm bid is obtained and (Y)&nbsp;two (2)&nbsp;Business
                                            Days after the Administrative Agent requests to refresh such firm bid; <U>provided</U> that
                                            the Administrative Agent may not request a refresh of any Collateral Asset more than once
                                            in any seven (7)&nbsp;calendar day period; <U>provided</U>, <U>further</U>, that if the Borrower
                                            has not provided such a firm bid within two (2)&nbsp;Business Days following such request
                                            by the Administrative Agent, then the Assigned Value shall be determined by the Administrative
                                            Agent (it being understood that such Assigned Value determined by the Administrative Agent
                                            shall remain subject to the Borrower&rsquo;s dispute rights set forth herein), (B)&nbsp;the
                                            Measurement Date following such determination and (C)&nbsp;the occurrence of a separate Revaluation
                                            Event with respect to such Collateral Asset;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><U>provided</U></FONT>,
<U>further</U>, that (A)&nbsp;under no circumstance may the Assigned Value determined pursuant to <U>clause (ii)</U>&nbsp;above be greater
than the initial Assigned Value in effect as of the related Cut-Off Date and (B)&nbsp;if (1)&nbsp;the Revaluation Event with respect
to any Qualifying Syndicated Loan has been cured and no other Revaluation Event has occurred and is continuing with respect to such Qualifying
Syndicated Loan and (2)&nbsp;the Servicer certifies to the Administrative Agent in writing (which may be via e-mail) that the event that
resulted in a Revaluation Event with respect to any Qualifying Syndicated Loan has been cured and no other Revaluation Event has occurred
with respect to such Qualifying Syndicated Loan then the Assigned Value with respect to such Qualifying Syndicated Loan may not be further
amended pursuant to this <U>clause (b)</U>; and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(c)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>with
respect to any other Eligible Collateral Asset, of any date of determination, the lowest of (i)&nbsp;the Purchase Price with respect
to such Collateral Asset, (ii)&nbsp;100% and (iii)&nbsp;the value of such Collateral Asset (expressed as a percentage of par) as determined
by the Administrative Agent in its sole discretion as notified to the Servicer in writing (x)&nbsp;as of the applicable Cut-Off Date
or (y)&nbsp;at any time from time to time following the occurrence of a Revaluation Event with respect to such Collateral Asset; <U>provided</U>
that with respect to this <U>clause (c)</U>:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(i)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">subject
                                            to <U>clauses (c)(ii)</U>&nbsp;through <U>(c)(v)</U>&nbsp;below, if a Revaluation Event occurs
                                            with respect to such Collateral Asset, the Assigned Value thereof may be amended at any time
                                            thereafter by the Administrative Agent, in its sole discretion;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(iii)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">if
                                            a Revaluation Event occurs with respect to such Collateral Asset (other than a Broadly Syndicated
                                            Loan with an observable bid-side quote with an indicated bid-depth of two or more following
                                            such Revaluation Event) and the Administrative Agent amends the Assigned Value with respect
                                            to such Collateral Asset, subject to the applicable Dispute Condition being satisfied and
                                            so long as no Event of Default has occurred and is continuing, the Borrower may (x)&nbsp;other
                                            than a Broadly Syndicated Loan with a bid-depth of one or more, obtain a firm bid for such
                                            Collateral Asset from an Approved Dealer or (y)&nbsp;retain any Approved Valuation Firm to
                                            value such Collateral Asset, which firm bid or value shall be determined, to the extent the
                                            Revaluation Event was based on financial information, with an as-of date after the financial
                                            information that gave rise to the related Revaluation Event has been made available, and,
                                            subject to <U>clause (c)(iv)</U>&nbsp;below, in respect of a Dispute Asset, the value determined
                                            pursuant to any of <U>subclause (x)</U>&nbsp;or <U>(y)</U>&nbsp;shall become the Assigned
                                            Value of such Collateral Asset, in either case, if it is greater than the Assigned Value
                                            determined by the Administrative Agent; <U>provided</U> that, except in the case of a Dispute
                                            Asset, if the Assigned Value is obtained by the Borrower pursuant to the means contemplated
                                            by <U>subclause (y)</U>&nbsp;above, the Administrative Agent may (at its own cost and expense)
                                            request such Collateral Asset be independently evaluated by another Approved Valuation Firm
                                            and, if the value determined pursuant to this proviso is less than the Borrower&rsquo;s determination
                                            pursuant to the means contemplated by <U>subclause (y)</U>&nbsp;above, then the Assigned
                                            Value of such Collateral Asset shall be equal to the arithmetic mean of (A)&nbsp;the value
                                            obtained by the Borrower pursuant to the means contemplated by <U>subclause (y)</U>&nbsp;above
                                            and (B)&nbsp;the greater of (1)&nbsp;the Assigned Value determined by the Administrative
                                            Agent prior to obtaining any independent valuation pursuant to this proviso and (2)&nbsp;the
                                            value obtained by the Administrative Agent pursuant to this proviso; <U>provided</U>, <U>further</U>,
                                            that under no circumstance may the Assigned Value determined pursuant to this <U>clause (c)(iii)</U>&nbsp;be
                                            greater than (I)&nbsp;solely in the case of a Dispute Asset, the initial Assigned Value in
                                            effect as of the related Cut-Off Date or (II)&nbsp;in the case of any other Collateral Asset,
                                            the Assigned Value in effect immediately prior to the occurrence of such Revaluation Event;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(iv)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">in
                                            respect of any Dispute Asset, the Assigned Value for such Dispute Asset shall be determined
                                            by (1)&nbsp;multiplying the initial Assigned Value thereof determined as of the Cut-Off Date
                                            by the Net Senior Leverage Multiple for such Dispute Asset (the &ldquo;<U>Dispute Asset Scaled
                                            Leverage Multiple</U>&rdquo;); (2)&nbsp;calculating a blended advance rate (the &ldquo;<U>Dispute
                                            Asset Effective Advance Rate</U>&rdquo;) as follows: (a)&nbsp;assigning the portion of such
                                            Dispute Asset up to 4.5x Dispute Asset Scaled Leverage Multiple, the Advance Rate applicable
                                            to such Dispute Asset (<U>provided</U> that, solely for this purpose, the Advance Rate applicable
                                            for Second Lien Bank Loans shall be 35%), (b)&nbsp;assigning the portion of such Dispute
                                            Asset in excess of <U>clause (a)</U>&nbsp;above, and up to 8.0x Dispute Asset Scaled Leverage
                                            Multiple, 35%, and (c)&nbsp;assigning the portion of such Dispute Asset in excess of <U>clause
                                            (b)</U>&nbsp;above, 0%; and (3)&nbsp;dividing the Dispute Asset Effective Advance Rate, by
                                            the Advance Rate applicable to such Dispute Asset (expressed as a percentage of par); and</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

                                            the &ldquo;Assigned Value&rdquo; pursuant to this <U>clause (c)(v)</U>&nbsp;is determined

                                            two (2)&nbsp;Business Days following such request by the Administrative Agent, then the Assigned
                                            Value shall be determined by the Administrative Agent (it being understood that such Assigned
                                            Value determined by the Administrative Agent shall remain subject to the Borrower&rsquo;s

    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->5<!-- Field: /Sequence --></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><U>provided</U></FONT>,
<U>further</U>, that, subject to <U>clause (v)</U>&nbsp;above, after the initial amendment to the Assigned Value with respect to any
such Collateral Asset, any additional amendment (other than an amendment as a result of the occurrence of a separate Revaluation Event)
shall only be on a quarterly (or monthly, as applicable) basis after receipt by the Administrative Agent from the Servicer of the applicable
information with respect to such Collateral Asset, and such additional amendment shall be based solely on further credit impairment rather
than the yield of such Collateral Asset and (B)&nbsp;if (1)&nbsp;the Revaluation Event with respect to any Collateral Asset has been
cured and no other Revaluation Event has occurred and is continuing with respect to such Collateral Asset and (2)&nbsp;the Servicer certifies
to the Administrative Agent in writing (which may be via e-mail) that the event that resulted in a Revaluation Event with respect to
any Collateral Asset has been cured and no other Revaluation Event has occurred with respect to such Collateral Asset then the Administrative
Agent may not subsequently amend the Assigned Value with respect to such Collateral Asset.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(d)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Notwithstanding
the foregoing, the Assigned Value of a Delayed Reporting Obligation shall not be amended by the Administrative Agent (other than at the
request of the Borrower) so long as (x)&nbsp;no other Revaluation Event with respect to such Delayed Reporting Obligation has occurred
and (y)&nbsp;the Servicer provides and continues to provide a certification in each financial reporting package with respect to such
Delayed Reporting Obligation that the failure to deliver the applicable audit results is due to technical or administrative delay related
to the audit or delay on the part of the related auditor and not due to any deterioration in the credit quality or extended review of
the credit quality of such Delayed Reporting Obligation or the related obligor.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(e)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Administrative Agent shall promptly notify the Servicer of any change effected by the Administrative Agent of the Assigned Value of any
Collateral Asset and neither the Borrower nor the Servicer shall have any obligation to make any calculations hereunder giving effect
to such lower Assigned Value until the Servicer has received such notice.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(f)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Administrative Agent may, upon request of the Servicer and at the discretion of the Administrative Agent, increase the Assigned Value
of any Eligible Collateral Asset from time to time.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Commitment
Fee Rate</U>&rdquo; means (x)&nbsp;with respect to the First Unused Amount, (i)&nbsp;from the Closing Date to and including June&nbsp;30,
2026, 0.0% and (ii)&nbsp;thereafter, 0.50% and (y)&nbsp;with respect to the Second Unused Amount, 1.75%; <U>provided</U> that, notwithstanding
the foregoing, during the Ramp-Up Period, for purposes of clauses (x)(ii)&nbsp;and (y)&nbsp;of this definition, the Commitment Fee Rate
shall mean 0.25%.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Delayed
Reporting Date</U>&rdquo; means, with respect to a Collateral Asset, the date specified for delivery of audit results included in a financial
reporting packet by the related obligor specified in the related Underlying Instruments (following the lapse of any grace period granted
by the applicable Loan Party with respect thereto, but in any event not greater than 45 calendar days).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->6<!-- Field: /Sequence --></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Delayed
Reporting Event</U>&rdquo; means, with respect to any applicable Collateral Asset a Revaluation Event described under clause (b)&nbsp;of
the definition thereof has occurred solely as a result of a failure of the related obligor to deliver any audit results included in the
applicable financial reporting package by the Delayed Reporting Date and such failure has not been cured.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Delayed
Reporting Obligation</U>&rdquo; means, as of any date of determination, any applicable Collateral Asset for which a Delayed Reporting
Event has occurred and is continuing.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Dispute
Asset</U>&rdquo; means, as of any date of determination, any Collateral Asset (other than a Qualifying Syndicated Loan, a Broadly Syndicated
Loan that has an observable bid-side quote with an indicated bid-depth of two or more, or a Permitted Collateral Asset) (i)&nbsp;that
was subject to a Revaluation Event of the type described in clause (d)&nbsp;of the definition thereof, (ii)&nbsp;for which the Dispute
Condition has been satisfied and (iii)&nbsp;the Borrower has exercised its dispute right in respect thereof pursuant to clause (c)(iii)(y)&nbsp;of
the definition of &ldquo;Assigned Value.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Dispute
Condition</U>&rdquo; means a condition that is satisfied with respect to a Collateral Asset if:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(a)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>a
Revaluation Event of the type described in clause (b)&nbsp;of the definition thereof has occurred with respect to such Collateral Asset
and the date of dispute by the Borrower is not later than the later of (x)&nbsp;90 days since the occurrence of such Revaluation Event
and (y)&nbsp;30 days after the Administrative Agent has provided the most recent notice of a decrease in the Assigned Value of such Collateral
Asset following such Revaluation Event (or such longer period as agreed to by the Administrative Agent in its sole discretion if such
failure is caused solely by operational delays of a third party, is unrelated to the performance of the Collateral and written notice
thereof has been provided to the Administrative Agent);</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(b)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>a
Revaluation Event of the type described in clause (d)&nbsp;of the definition thereof has occurred with respect to such Collateral Asset;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(c)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>a
Revaluation Event of the type described in clause (e)&nbsp;of the definition thereof has occurred with respect to such Collateral Asset
as a result of:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(i)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>a
Material Modification of the type described in clause (b)(ii)&nbsp;of the definition thereof and either such Collateral Asset is deferring
or capitalizing interest (i)&nbsp;for less than six months or (ii)&nbsp;for longer than six months and the Weighted Average Spread Test
is satisfied;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(ii)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>a
Material Modification of the type described in clause (b)(iii)&nbsp;of the definition thereof and the Interest Coverage Ratio of the
related obligor with respect to such Collateral Asset was greater than 2.0x immediately prior to such Material Modification;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 7; Value: 2 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->7<!-- Field: /Sequence --></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(iii)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>a
Material Modification of the type described in clause (c)&nbsp;of the definition thereof has occurred and (A)&nbsp;if such Collateral
Asset is a Second Lien Bank Loan, the condition set forth in clause (d)(ii)&nbsp;of the definition of &ldquo;Revaluation Event&rdquo;
is not satisfied or (B)&nbsp;if such Collateral Asset is a First Lien Bank Loan or a FILO Bank Loan, the resulting subordination is to
an asset-backed loan and based on the most recently available quarterly financial statements of the related obligor received by the applicable
Loan Party, such asset-backed loan has a ratio of the maximum aggregate principal amount outstanding or available to be drawn under the
applicable underlying instruments to EBITDA of such obligor not greater than 3.0x, <U>provided</U> that, if the Borrower disputes the
Assigned Value of a First Lien Bank Loan in accordance with this <U>subclause (iii)</U>, such First Lien Bank Loan will be treated as
a FILO Bank Loan for all purposes under the Credit Agreement at the direction of the Administrative Agent if such asset-backed loan has
a ratio of the maximum aggregate principal amount outstanding or available to be drawn under the applicable underlying instruments to
EBITDA of such obligor greater than 1.25x based on the most recent available quarterly financial statements of the related obligor received
by the applicable Loan Party;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(iv)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>a
Material Modification of the type described in clause (d)&nbsp;of the definition thereof and after giving effect to such extension, (A)&nbsp;the
maturity date of such Collateral Asset is (i)&nbsp;no later than thirteen (13) months past the maturity date (as determined as of the
related Cut-Off Date) or (ii)&nbsp;later than thirteen (13) months past the maturity date (as determined as of the related Cut-Off Date),
and both (x)&nbsp;the related obligor&rsquo;s EBITDA has not declined more than 25% over the past year and (y)&nbsp;the date of dispute
by the Borrower is not later than the later of (1)&nbsp;the end of the Availability Period and (2)&nbsp;30 days from the first reduction
in Assigned Value of such Collateral Asset in connection with such Material Modification or (B)&nbsp;in the case of an extension of the
amortization schedule with respect to such Collateral Asset, the average life of such Collateral Asset is extended (i)&nbsp;no later
than thirteen (13) months (from the amortization schedule in effect as of the related Cut-Off Date) or (ii)&nbsp;later than thirteen
(13) months (from the amortization schedule in effect as of the related Cut-Off Date), and both (x)&nbsp;the related obligor&rsquo;s
EBITDA has not declined more than 25% over the past year and (y)&nbsp;the date of dispute by the Borrower is not later than the later
of (1)&nbsp;the end of the Availability Period and (2)&nbsp;30 days from the first reduction in Assigned Value of such Collateral Asset
in connection with such Material Modification;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(v)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>a
Material Modification of the type described in clause (g)&nbsp;of the definition thereof has occurred with respect to such Collateral
Asset and such modification does not result in any change in the currency of any payment of interest or principal to any currency other
than another Eligible Currency that was contemplated by the Underlying Instruments immediately prior to such modification; or</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->8<!-- Field: /Sequence --></P></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(vi)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>a
Revaluation Event of the type described in clause (h)&nbsp;of the definition thereof has occurred with respect to such Collateral Asset
and the related dispute right conditions, if any, have been satisfied.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&ldquo;<U>First
Unused Amount</U>&rdquo; means, as of any date of determination, the lesser of (x)&nbsp;the Unused Amount and (y)(i)&nbsp;from the Closing
Date to and including June&nbsp;30, 2026, an amount equal to 75.0% of the Aggregate Commitments </FONT>of non-Defaulting Lenders, (ii)&nbsp;from
July&nbsp;1, 2026 to and including September&nbsp;30, 2026, an amount equal to 55.0% of the Aggregate Commitments of non-Defaulting Lenders
and (iii)&nbsp;thereafter, an amount equal to 40.0% of the Aggregate Commitments of non-Defaulting Lenders.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Make-Whole
Percentage</U>&rdquo; means (a)&nbsp;prior to the first anniversary of the Closing Date, 1.00%, and (b)&nbsp;thereafter, zero.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Prohibited
Obligation</U>&rdquo; means any Collateral Asset, the obligor with respect to which is primarily engaged in the business of trading,
producing or marketing marijuana, or, to the Servicer&rsquo;s actual knowledge, is categorized or deemed to be a &ldquo;Marijuana Related
Business&rdquo; under applicable law.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Ramp-Up
Period</U>&rdquo; means each period (i)&nbsp;commencing on the Closing Date, any Business Day on which the aggregate Commitments of the
Lenders are increased by at least $100,000,000 or the date of any Securitization and (ii)&nbsp;in each case, ending on the four month
anniversary of the applicable date specified in clause (i).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Revalued
Collateral Asset</U>&rdquo; means any Collateral Asset which has been subject to a Revaluation Event that resulted in the Administrative
Agent reducing (or, in the case of any Broadly Syndicated Loan or Qualifying Syndicated Loan, a reduction of) the Assigned Value for
such Collateral Asset below the Assigned Value as of the related Cut-Off Date; <U>provided</U> that such Collateral Asset (other than
any Broadly Syndicated Loan or Qualifying Syndicated Loan) shall not be deemed a Revalued Collateral Asset for any period that commences
(i)&nbsp;after the applicable Dispute Condition is satisfied for 3 consecutive months and ends on (ii)&nbsp;the earlier to occur of the
date (x)&nbsp;the Dispute Condition is no longer satisfied and (y)&nbsp;the Assigned Value of such Collateral Asset is no longer able
to be disputed by the Borrower.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Second
Unused Amount</U>&rdquo; means, as of any date of determination, an amount equal to the Unused Amount minus the First Unused Amount.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">2.&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>CLO
Takeouts</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(a)</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Notwithstanding
                                            anything in the Credit Agreement or any other Loan Document that would prohibit or restrict
                                            the sale of a Collateral Asset but subject to the final paragraph of this <U>Section&nbsp;2</U>,
                                            if a collateralized loan obligation facility (&ldquo;<U>CLO</U>&rdquo;) managed by the Servicer,
                                            GC Advisors LLC or an Affiliate thereof has priced or is expected to price and it is intended
                                            that the portfolio for such CLO include certain Collateral Assets (or portions thereof) constituting
                                            part of the Collateral under the Credit Agreement (any such transfer of Collateral Assets,
                                            a &ldquo;<U>CLO Takeout</U>&rdquo;), then:</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(i)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">at
                                            least two&nbsp;(2)&nbsp;Business Days prior to the date of any CLO Takeout, the Servicer,
                                            on behalf of the applicable Loan Party, shall provide the Administrative Agent and the Collateral
                                            Custodian (x)&nbsp;a Borrowing Base Certificate showing that, after giving <I>pro forma </I>effect
                                            to such CLO Takeout, no Borrowing Base Deficiency will exist, (y)&nbsp;a certificate of the
                                            Servicer substantially in the form of Exhibit&nbsp;E-2 to the Credit Agreement requesting
                                            the release of the related Collateral Asset Files in connection with such CLO Takeout, and
                                            (z)&nbsp;a schedule that identifies the Collateral Assets (or portion thereof) to be sold
                                            in connection with the applicable CLO, the actual sale prices of such Collateral Assets (or
                                            if the sale price is not available, the then-current fair market value of such Collateral
                                            Assets, as determined by the Servicer&rsquo;s internal valuation policy), and the actual
                                            or expected, as applicable, CLO pricing and closing dates; <U>provided</U> that (1)&nbsp;if
                                            such schedule must be revised prior to the applicable CLO Takeout for the purposes of, among
                                            other things, reflecting paydowns and/or the removal of a Collateral Asset due to the failure
                                            of such Collateral Asset to satisfy the eligibility criteria required by the applicable CLO
                                            after such schedule is delivered by the Borrower to the Administrative Agent pursuant to
                                            this <U>clause (i)(z)</U>; or (2)&nbsp;if the actual sale price is not available at the time
                                            such schedule is delivered by the Borrower to the Administrative Agent pursuant to this <U>clause
                                            (i)(z)</U>, the Borrower shall provide prompt written notice to the Administrative Agent
                                            once such revisions are made and/or once such sale price is available;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(ii)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">if
                                            the actual sale price of the applicable Collateral Assets for the CLO Takeout are lower than
                                            the sale price (or market value, as applicable) set forth on the schedule delivered pursuant
                                            to <U>clause (i)(z)</U>, then such CLO Takeout may still be consummated, <U>provided</U>
                                            that (x)&nbsp;if such CLO Takeout occurs during the Availability Period, if a Borrowing Base
                                            Deficiency would occur solely as a result of such price difference, then, unless the Administrative
                                            Agent waives the requirements of this <U>clause (ii)(x)</U>, the Borrower shall cure such
                                            Borrowing Base Deficiency prior to the CLO Takeout occurring, and (y)&nbsp;if such CLO Takeout
                                            occurs after the Availability Period, unless the Administrative Agent waives any of the below
                                            requirements, (1)&nbsp;no Borrowing Base Deficiency (i)&nbsp;exists after giving effect to
                                            such CLO Takeout unless such CLO Takeout is effected pursuant to a BBD Cure Plan delivered
                                            pursuant to Section&nbsp;2.03(b)&nbsp;of the Credit Agreement or (ii)&nbsp;would occur as
                                            a result of such CLO Takeout, (2)&nbsp;no Currency Asset Amount Shortfall (solely with respect
                                            to any CLO Takeout of Collateral Assets denominated in the same Eligible Currency as any
                                            such Currency Asset Amount Shortfall) exists after giving effect to such CLO Takeout unless
                                            such Currency Asset Amount Shortfall is maintained or decreased, and (3)&nbsp;prior to such
                                            CLO Takeout, if such price is less than the Assigned Value for such Collateral Asset, the
                                            Borrower deposits into the Collection Account an amount equal to the difference (if any)
                                            between (I)&nbsp;the lower of the Assigned Value of such Collateral Asset and the sale price
                                            (or market value, as applicable) set forth on the schedule delivered pursuant to <U>clause
                                            (i)</U>&nbsp;above and (II)&nbsp;such sale price; and</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 10; Value: 2 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->10<!-- Field: /Sequence --></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(iii)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">notwithstanding
                                            anything in the Credit Agreement or any other Loan Document to the contrary, except to the
                                            extent explicitly set forth in this <U>Section&nbsp;2</U> (including as set forth in the
                                            immediately succeeding proviso), the sale and settlement of such Collateral Assets (or portions
                                            thereof) in connection with the applicable CLO Takeout shall not be subject to any conditions,
                                            consents, restrictions, prohibitions or rescission under the Credit Agreement, regardless
                                            of whether any Event of Default or Default has occurred or is continuing on or prior to the
                                            date of such sale of the applicable Collateral Assets; <U>provided</U>, that if an Event
                                            of Default has occurred and is continuing, no pricing of such CLO Takeout shall occur without
                                            the prior written consent of the Administrative Agent (in its sole discretion); <U>provided</U>,
                                            <U>further</U> that if an Event of Default has occurred and is continuing but the related
                                            CLO priced prior to the occurrence of such Event of Default, the sale and settlement of such
                                            Collateral Assets (or portions thereof) in connection with the applicable CLO Takeout shall
                                            be permitted notwithstanding the occurrence of such Event of Default, unless the settlement
                                            period for such sale of Collateral Assets is greater than eight (8)&nbsp;weeks from the pricing
                                            date of the related CLO, in which case the written consent of the Administrative Agent (in
                                            its sole discretion) shall be required for such sale and settlement.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">For the avoidance of doubt,
(i)&nbsp;the release of any Securitization Subsidiary Collateral, including the release of such Collateral Assets in connection with
a Securitization, shall be deemed to be a sale for purposes of this <U>Section&nbsp;2</U> and Sections 2.15(a)(iii), 2.15(a)(v), 2.15(b),
2.15(c), 2.15(d), and 2.15(f)&nbsp;of the Credit Agreement and (ii)&nbsp;the termination and release of any Securitization Subsidiary
shall be subject to Section&nbsp;2.18 of the Credit Agreement and Section&nbsp;2.3 of the Security Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">3.&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Expenses</U>.
It is understood and agreed that the fees, expenses, and disbursements of Orrick, Herrington&nbsp;&amp; Sutcliffe LLP, counsel to the
Administrative Agent, in connection with the transactions contemplated by the Credit Agreement on or prior to the Closing Date, will
be subject to a cap of $75,000.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">4.&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Confidentiality</U>.
The terms of this Second Amended and Restated Side Letter shall be subject to Section&nbsp;11.07 of the Credit Agreement, <I>mutatis
mutandis</I>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">5.&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Amendments;
Counterparts; Governing Law; Etc.</U> This Second Amended and Restated Side Letter may not be amended or modified, or any provision hereof
waived, except by an instrument in writing signed by each of the parties hereto. This Second Amended and Restated Side Letter may be
executed in any number of counterparts, each of which shall be an original and all of which, when taken together, shall constitute one
agreement. Delivery of an executed signature page&nbsp;of this Second Amended and Restated Side Letter by facsimile (or other electronic)
transmission shall be effective as delivery of a manually executed counterpart hereof. Section&nbsp;headings used herein are for convenience
of reference only, are not part of this Second Amended and Restated Side Letter and are not to affect the construction of, or to be taken
into consideration in interpreting, this Second Amended and Restated Side Letter. This Second Amended and Restated Side Letter sets forth
the entire agreement between the parties hereto as to the matters set forth herein and supersedes all prior understandings, whether written
or oral, between the parties hereto with respect to the matters herein. Matters that are not covered or made clear in this Second Amended
and Restated Side Letter are subject to mutual agreement of the parties hereto. <B>THIS SECOND AMENDED AND RESTATED SIDE LETTER AND ANY
CLAIMS, CONTROVERSY, DISPUTE OR CAUSE OF ACTION (WHETHER IN CONTRACT OR TORT OR OTHERWISE) BASED UPON, ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO
THIS SECOND AMENDED AND RESTATED SIDE LETTER AND THE TRANSACTIONS CONTEMPLATED HEREBY SHALL BE GOVERNED BY, AND CONSTRUED IN ACCORDANCE
WITH, THE LAW OF THE STATE OF NEW YORK</B>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">6.&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Jurisdiction</U>.
Each of the parties hereto hereby irrevocably and unconditionally (a)&nbsp;submits, for itself and its property, to the exclusive jurisdiction
of the courts of the State of New York sitting in the County of New York and of the United Stated District Court of the Southern District
of New York, and any appellate court from any thereof, in any action or proceeding arising out of or relating to this Second Amended
and Restated Side Letter or the transactions contemplated hereby, or for recognition or enforcement of any judgment, and agrees that
all claims in respect of any such action, litigation or proceeding shall be heard and determined only in such courts located within New
York County or, to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, in such federal court; (b)&nbsp;irrevocably and unconditionally waives,
to the fullest extent it may legally and effectively do so, any objection which it may now or hereafter have to the laying of venue of
any suit, action or proceeding arising out of or relating to this Second Amended and Restated Side Letter or the transactions contemplated
hereby in any court referred to in clause (a)&nbsp;above, (c)&nbsp;irrevocably waives, to the fullest extent permitted by law, the defense
of an inconvenient forum to the maintenance of such action or proceeding in any such court and (d)&nbsp;agrees that a final judgment
in any such action, litigation or proceeding shall be conclusive and may be enforced in other jurisdictions by suit on the judgment or
in any other manner provided by law. Nothing in this Second Amended and Restated Side Letter shall affect any right that you may otherwise
have to bring any action or proceeding with regard to the enforcement of a judgement ordered by any court of the State of New York sitting
in New York County or of the United States District Court of the Southern District of New York, or any appellate court from any thereof,
relating to this Second Amended and Restated Side Letter against us or our properties in the courts of any jurisdiction.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">7.&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Waiver
of Jury Trial</U>. <B>EACH PARTY HERETO HEREBY IRREVOCABLY WAIVES, TO THE FULLEST EXTENT PERMITTED BY APPLICABLE LAW, ANY RIGHT IT MAY&nbsp;HAVE
TO A TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY LEGAL PROCEEDING DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS SECOND AMENDED AND RESTATED SIDE
LETTER OR THE TRANSACTIONS CONTEMPLATED HEREBY OR THEREBY (WHETHER BASED ON CONTRACT, TORT OR ANY OTHER THEORY).</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>
